INSERT INTO payments (magicNumberId, amount, networkFee, transactionHash, paymentDate, notificationSent, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT id, '150.00', '1.50', 'd6ba8..c9a2a', NOW(), 1, NOW(), NOW()
FROM magic_numbers 
WHERE magicNumber = '22739' 
LIMIT 1;
